actions.name: Sent invoice-themed phishing emails to US election officials
actions.description: On 5 October 2021, unidentified cyber actors targeted US election officials in at least nine states, and representatives of the National Association of Secretaries of State, with phishing emails containing an attachment titled 'INVOICE INQUIRY.PDF' which redirected users to a credential-harvesting website.

actions.name: Sent phishing emails from a compromised US government official’s email account
actions.description: One of the email addresses sending the phishing emails on 5 October 2021 was a compromised US government official’s email account.

actions.name: Sent phishing emails with Microsoft Word invoice attachments to county election employees
actions.description: On 18 October 2021, cyber actors used two email addresses, purportedly from US businesses, to send phishing emails to county election employees. Both emails contained Microsoft Word document attachments regarding invoices, which redirected users to unidentified online credential harvesting websites.
actions.epistemic_reason: 原文以不確定語氣陳述（如 may have／appears to／we believe），不是已確認的事實。

actions.name: Sent phishing email with fake invoice Microsoft Word attachment to an election official
actions.description: On 19 October 2021, cyber actors used an email address, purportedly from a US business, to send a phishing email containing fake invoices to an election official. The email contained an attached Microsoft Word document titled, 'Current Invoice and Payments for report.'
actions.epistemic_reason: 原文以不確定語氣陳述（如 may have／appears to／we believe），不是已確認的事實。
